body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance (caching, event-driven, zero idle cost); (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps** so mods touching those APIs "just work", as if one big map.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. **See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface**; basement is routing-only.
- Basement default is solid rock; **with Biomes! Caverns loaded it generates as a living cavern (2026-07-21, user-approved change to the old solid-rock lock)**.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat between levels (user directive, run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type; native walls keep vanilla edge lips; fogged deep interior = vanilla fog. USER-VERIFIED run #17.
- **THE OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip (KindLedge)** — meadows start 1 cell back exactly like ledges, or the rock face below stops rendering (run #43 regression, fixed).
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: gates are `level == 1`; with additional map levels they MUST become "topmost level of the column". Comments at both sites.
- **Pod transit handoff is LATE**: `HandoffTicksToImpact = 22`.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (runs #1-#15) — all USER-VERIFIED
Cross-level combat, ritual attendance, wild-animal wandering, universal targeting hub, sky-view mountain rendering. Pod transit + AA interception USER-VERIFIED run #39.

## 2026-07-21 FEATURE TRANCHE (runs #40-#47)
### 1. Destination-aware stair routing (Movement/StairRouter.cs) — BUILT, self-test in place
Whole-trip scoring (pawn->stairs + climb-as-cells + exit->dest) with pawn-less PassDoors dest-side filter, never bricks. Consumers keep one virtual scan then Reroute by discovered destination. Wired: work/needs/joy/rest/food migration, medical + prisoner transport, haul verdict cache (stores cell), fetch giver, right-click orders (click cell), attack chase, ritual gather, caravan gather (meetingPoint FieldRefAccess). Deliberately not: hostiles, idle-return, go-up/down gizmo, animal wander. API dest overloads. Dev: `AB: stair-routing self-test`.

### 2. Biomes! Caverns basements — WORKING runs #41-#47
GenStep_ABCavernCarve (order 210): connected worm network + chambers, openness slider; biome swap via deep-scribed `map.pocketTileInfo.PrimaryBiome`; weighted random (Fungal 50/Crystal 35/Earthen 15 — **Earthen is 55C**, `constantOutdoorTemperature` beats pocket temp) or fixed dropdown; **random roll CONFIRMED varying across runs**. Biome-authentic floors (their patchMakers + fertility bands), auto rock pillars for roof support, BC stalagmite/crystal scatterers by defName, initial flora/fauna (sealed maps get no edge spawns). KNOWN-BENIGN: "Scatterer ... could not find cell" ~1x/gen (their radius-5 validators vs our tunnels; optional polish: chamber freq 0.02->0.035). Dev: `AB: cavern-basement self-test`.

### 3. Naturalistic mountain peaks — VISUALS ITERATED THROUGH run #47 (user: "this is great" x2)
- ONE meadow field (Perlin 0.024, cutoff 0.60 = ~70-75% rock) decides rock vs open across the mass. Open zone = meadow to one cell short of the edge (lip ring locked); rock zone = classic wandering ledge 1-4 + wall. Internal rock/meadow boundaries are the cliffs. Legacy path intact (setting off / plateau-less component). Enclosed meadows refogged = hidden valleys.
- Plateau: rough stone/gravel/soil (arable slider), surface-biome flora (vegetation slider, no cave plants), outcrop mounts. Unroofed; rim/outcrops thick-roofed (mined-peak rule holds). AB_OpenSky biome: plantDensity 0.35 + hardy highland wildPlants (DICTIONARY form — run-40 lesson) for regrowth.
- **Fade skirt (SectionLayer_ABMountainCap)**: meadow ground counts as Linked (no atlas wall lip toward meadows); open mass cells emit vertex-alpha gradient strips (shared white VertexColor mat, queue lowQueue+1, per-rock tone via TryGetMinedRockColor) 0.8 cells into adjacent meadow, near alpha 150 (run-46 user tuning: dimmer/longer). Native walls/outcrops keep vanilla lips on purpose (standing rock on ground).
- Dev: `AB: peak-plateau self-test`.

### 4. Camera level lock (QoL, run #47+)
KeyBindingDef `AB_CameraLevelLock` (default End, mod key category, rebindable). Toggles `LevelCamera.LevelLocked` (session-scoped, not scribed): while ON, automatic level switches are suppressed — `FollowPawn` (stair-follow camera ride) early-returns; manual switches (PageUp/PageDown hotkeys, level widget, gizmos) always work. Polled in ABGameComp.GameComponentOnGUI ahead of the view hotkeys, event consumed. Setting `cameraLockKeybind` (default on) disables the hotkey. On/off Messages.

### Fixes landed during verification
- Run #40: BiomeDef wildPlants li-record format aborted the whole AB_Biomes.xml load -> null pocket biome -> VacuumComponent NRE cascade. Dictionary form; lore saved (defs).
- Run #41: sky auto-roof guard NRE on mid-rebuild rooms with detached regions; guard validates room.Regions (null/valid/Map) and skips transient rooms.

### Settings added
naturalPeaks + peakSoilFraction + peakVegetation; cavernBasements + cavernBiome + cavernOpenness (BC-gated); cameraLockKeybind. Settings window scroll view.

### Roadmap
Ongoing: vanilla-API parity audit. Deferred: cell-targeted ability casts, beam turrets, scribed turret orders, multi-select formations, cross-level prisoner/animal ritual participation, T9 soak, T5 publishing. Watch: stalagmite density polish, cavern steady-state fauna respawn.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub / animal-wander / ritual-attendance / mech-overseer / bond+home / pod-transit / stair-routing / cavern-basement / peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell (T:); toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select pawns/items in place; bidirectional right-click orders + Reverse Commands; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH water riser, VEF generic duct, Rimefeller chem riser, VCHE chemfuel riser. Biomes! Caverns cavern basements (soft, defName-only). Anti-air interception (verified #39). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of explicit scope.

## Status
2026-07-21: Tranche near-done — routing + caverns working in-game, peak visuals user-approved through two "this is great" rounds (final fade tuning awaiting one look), camera level lock built. Next: verify fade tuning + camera lock in one run, then older outstanding items (mech overseer diagnosis, bond/home checks, VCHE companion run), soak, publishing prep.
